body: sync_shelves (kobo.py:2455-2465) deletes the ShelfArchive row while emitting its DeletedTag. With two Kobos on one account, only the first device to sync receives the tombstone; the second keeps a ghost collection retrying deletes. Pending-page replay only covers the same device. Upstream-inherited. CONFIDENCE: likely. Source: adversarial audit state/kobo-audit-2026-09-01.
title: Shelf tombstone has a single consumer: second device on the same account never receives DeletedTag and keeps a ghost collection
